description: On a fixed 1024x768 output, the dock surface uses the full output width and the 220px panel sits exactly at center x=402.

assertions.comment: On a fixed 1024x768 output, the dock surface uses output width 1024px. This harness does not generate the dynamic resolution-change signal itself
The fixed-output content width of the unnamed panel path (0/0/2) is 220px
On the fixed output, panel x is calculated as (1024-220)/2=402 and is exactly centered. Reproducing geometryChanged is out of scope
The unnamed Flow path (0/0/2/1) centers the 204px icon row at x=8 inside the 220px panel
